title: My BMW app status and address sending
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on My BMW app functions for sending addresses and viewing vehicle status, alongside many case-management notes about customers sending photos and one unrelated complaint about an awkwardly shaped compartment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the app for letting users send addresses to the car and check vehicle status, and one also recalls appreciation for small ownership gifts.

negative.summary: Negative feedback includes a complaint that a compartment is awkwardly shaped and hard to use, which appears only loosely related to the main app and photo-sharing theme.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly document customers saying they will send photos or would prefer better app behavior for address sending and real-time status updates, without a clear overall sentiment in many cases.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined case notes about sending photos, which limits clear interpretation of customer satisfaction.
The topic mixes app functions, photo-sharing follow-up, and at least one unrelated physical storage-compartment complaint, so it is not fully coherent.
Examples are insufficient to determine whether the address-sending and real-time status concerns are widespread beyond these sampled comments.
